req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint must: (1) return HTTP 200 with the updated task on valid input, (2) return HTTP 404 for non-existent task IDs, (3) support partial updates (only provided fields change), (4) enforce field constraints (title min_length=1, max_length=100, description max_length=500), (5) handle boundary values for string lengths. Tests use pre-loaded rows (ids 1-20) and assert exact values to maximise mutation kill rate. Each test overrides the DB with an in-memory SQLite so it is isolated and idempotent.

tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = 'sqlite:///:memory:'
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

from app import models
db = TestingSessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=4, title='Prepare meeting agenda', description='Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix.', completed=False))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data():
    r = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'title': 'Updated agenda', 'description': 'New desc', 'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 4
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated agenda'
    assert body['description'] == 'New desc'
    assert body['completed'] == True

test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
